title: Broadcast content (authored, static)
description: The single authored artefact of the site: the Bells Corners radio broadcast and its stations. Validated by tests/unit/broadcastContent.test.ts. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (strictly increasing frequencies, contiguous order, minimum station spacing) are asserted in that same test — see data-model.md.

intro.description: The single instruction shown before the first lock-in (FR-001).

signOff.description: The closing broadcast shown once every station is received (FR-012).

band.description: The frequency range the dial spans. Every station frequency must fall inside it.

id.description: URL-safe slug. Appears in deep links (FR-018) and storage keys — stable once shared.

order.description: 1-based, unique, contiguous, matching the order along the road (FR-004).

frequency.description: Position on the band and the on-screen ident, e.g. 101.7. Strictly increasing with order; adjacent stations at least 0.4 apart so lock zones cannot overlap.

callSign.description: Optional decorative ident, e.g. CBLL. Never the only carrier of meaning (FR-021).

dialLabel.description: Optional very short label printed on the band; falls back to the frequency.

downtownTranslation.description: Optional comparison to something familiar downtown (FR-007).

visuals.description: The first entry is the hero visual (FR-007).

src.description: Vite-resolved asset URL for a file under src/content/media/.

alt.description: Meaningful text alternative — required for every visual (FR-021).
